name: feature.sales-commissions.nodes
description: Sales Commissions node pack — two READ nodes over the ctx.features.commissions surface: list commission plans, and list statements (subject-scoped to the run owner unless they hold host:commissions:manage). PLUS two GOVERNED WRITE nodes: compute-statement and approve-statement, which enforce the run OWNER's host:commissions:manage scope (system runs denied) and are kept OUT of the advisory agent's allowlist. NOTE (CFP-1 / D9): the app drives the governed statement approval through the SHARED reviews approval gate (kind: commission-statement), not a direct agent tool call — no built-in workflow ignites these nodes; they stay composable catalog entries for a builder-authored chain. All nodes are role:"action", tenant+org-guarded (CTI-1); tenantId comes from the run scope, never node args.
author: OpenWOP App

nodes.label: Commissions: List Plans
nodes.description: Lists an org's commission plans over ctx.features.commissions.listPlans. Inputs: { orgId }. Output: { plans }. Tenant+org-guarded.

nodes.label: Commissions: List Statements
nodes.description: Lists commission statements over ctx.features.commissions.listStatements — SUBJECT-SCOPED to the run owner (a rep sees only their own) unless the owner holds host:commissions:manage. Inputs: { orgId, subjectId?, period?, planId? }. Output: { statements }.

nodes.label: Commissions: Compute Statement
nodes.description: GOVERNED WRITE (ADR 0280 P4) — computes (upserts a draft) a rep's commission statement for a period over ctx.features.commissions.computeStatement, composing territory attainment. Enforces host:commissions:manage against the RUN OWNER (system runs denied). Not in the advisory agent's allowlist. NOTE (CFP-1 / D9): no built-in workflow ignites this node — the app's actual governed approval rides the SHARED reviews approval gate (kind: commission-statement); this node stays a composable catalog entry. Inputs: { orgId, planId, subjectId, period }. Output: { success, statement }.

nodes.label: Commissions: Submit Statement for Approval
nodes.description: GOVERNED WRITE (ADR 0280 P4) — SUBMITS a draft commission statement for human review over ctx.features.commissions.approveStatement. It does NOT approve it: R2 COM2-M3 — applying the transition here let a chain approve every draft statement in an org with no review card and no second person, stamping an unattributable `run:<id>` as approver on a payout record. A human decides in the shared Reviews inbox (host:commissions:manage). Enforces host:commissions:manage against the run owner (system runs denied). Inputs: { orgId, statementId }. Output: { success, submittedForReview, review: { approvalId, status } } — the statement stays `draft` until a human approves it.
